plan.scenario.freeze-power-loss.immediat: If an essential device loses power, follow its care plan and the backup you arranged. In an emergency, call {emergencyNumber}.
Never use an oven, stove, grill, or camp heater to heat your home.
Use a generator only outdoors, at least 20 feet from windows, doors, and vents. Never run one in a home or garage.
If heat stays off, go early to the warm place you agreed on, while travel is still possible.
Keep the refrigerator and freezer closed. Use stored water first.
plan.scenario.heat-grid-strain.immediate: Move to your agreed cooled place before the home heats up, especially anyone who is heat-sensitive.
A fan alone may not prevent heat illness in extreme heat.
Call {emergencyNumber} for signs of heat stroke, such as confusion, fainting, or a very high body temperature.
Ask the care provider in advance how heat or a power outage affects medicines and equipment. Do not change medicines on your own.
plan.scenario.tornado.immediate.1: At a tornado warning, go immediately to your shelter spot: lowest floor, interior room, away from windows.
plan.scenario.tornado.immediate.2: Cover your head and neck. Help anyone who needs assistance to get there.
plan.scenario.tornado.immediate.3: Keep a way to receive warnings at night, such as phone alerts or a weather radio.
plan.scenario.tornado.immediate.4: Do not try to travel to a distant shelter once a warning is issued unless officials direct it and you planned it in advance.
plan.scenario.flash-flood.immediate.1: Turn around, don't drown: never walk, swim, or drive through flood water.
plan.scenario.flash-flood.immediate.2: Move to higher ground right away when told to, or when water is rising. Follow official instructions.
plan.scenario.flash-flood.immediate.3: Never drive around barricades. Map directions do not show whether a road is flooded.
plan.scenario.flash-flood.immediate.4: If you have no car, contact your agreed ride or local officials early, before roads close.
plan.scenario.home-fire.immediate.1: Get out and stay out. Never go back inside for people, pets, or belongings.
plan.scenario.home-fire.immediate.2: Use your second way out if smoke or fire blocks the first. Crawl low under smoke.
plan.scenario.home-fire.immediate.3: Go to the outside meeting point, then call {emergencyNumber} from outside.
plan.scenario.home-fire.immediate.4: If you cannot get out, close the door, cover vents and cracks, call {emergencyNumber}, and signal from a window.
plan.scenario.water-outage.immediate.1: Follow the exact advisory from your water utility. Different advisories need different actions.
plan.scenario.water-outage.immediate.2: Boil water advisory: use bottled or stored water, or bring tap water to a rolling boil for 1 minute (3 minutes above 6,500 feet), as your utility advises.
plan.scenario.water-outage.immediate.3: Do not drink advisory: do not drink the tap water and do not boil it. Boiling does not remove chemicals.
plan.scenario.water-outage.immediate.4: Do not use advisory: do not use tap water for any purpose. Use stored or bottled water.
